# KCP International Japanese Language School

> > KCP International Japanese Language School in Tokyo, Japan offers immersive Japanese language study abroad programs with cultural activities and student experiences in Shinjuku.

This site documents student experiences, cultural activities, and practical information for KCP International's Japanese language programs in Tokyo. Content includes student reviews, cultural excursions to historic sites like Kamakura and Asakusa, traditional activities like tea ceremony and cooking classes, and practical tips for studying abroad in Japan.

## Key Topics

- KCP International Japanese Language School
- Tokyo study abroad
- Japanese language learning
- Shinjuku campus location
- Student cultural experiences
- Traditional Japanese culture
- Tea ceremony
- Tokyo dining and restaurants
- Historic sites (Kamakura, Asakusa, Kyoto)
- Student activities and excursions
- Japanese Buddhism and temples
- Edo period history
- Student life in Tokyo
- Cultural immersion programs

## Campus & Program Information

- [The KCP Locale](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2011/02/the-kcp-locale): KCP campus location in Shinjuku with transportation and area information
- [New tips on getting the most out of KCP](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2010/11/the-guys-have-it-new-tips-on-getting-the-most-out-of-kcp): Student tips for maximizing KCP study abroad experience in Tokyo
- [Free Stuff in Tokyo](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2009/11/free-stuff-in-tokyo): Budget-friendly free attractions and activities guide for Tokyo visitors
- [Leaving early](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2011/03/leaving-early): KCP emergency response during Fukushima crisis and early departure policy
- [KCP Holds Technical School Fair](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2011/08/kcp-holds-technical-school-fair): Technical school fair introduces students to vocational education options

## Cultural Activities & Experiences

- [Winter 2018 Class Experience the Tea Ceremony](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2018/02/winter-2018-class-experience-tea-ceremony): Winter 2018 students participate in traditional Japanese tea ceremony
- [Cooking Up Some Fun with KCP Spring 2017 Batch](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2017/08/cooking-up-some-fun-with-kcp-spring-2017-batch): Spring 2017 students learn Japanese cooking and traditional ingredients
- [Origami: Japanese Paper Folding](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2011/08/origami-japanese-paper-folding): Japanese origami art history, techniques, and cultural significance
- [The Abacus, Unplugged](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2010/10/the-abacus-unplugged): Japanese soroban abacus history and traditional calculating methods

## Student Excursions & Tours

- [Summer KCP Students Go on a Half-Day Tokyo Tour](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2011/07/summer-kcp-students-go-on-a-half-day-tokyo-tour): Summer students tour Akihabara, Harajuku, and Meiji Jingu shrine in Tokyo
- [KCP Spring 2017 Batch Visit Kamakura](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2017/11/kcp-spring-2017-batch-visit-kamakura): Spring 2017 student excursion to historic Kamakura temples and sites
- [KCP F-2016 at the National Diet Building and Asakusa](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2017/12/kcp-fall-2016-students-national-diet-building-and-asakusa): Fall 2016 students visit National Diet Building and Asakusa district
- [Roaming around Shinjuku with Emily Cole](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2013/05/shinjuku-emily-cole): Fall 2012 student Emily Cole's photo tour of Shinjuku neighborhood

## Student Stories & Alumni

- [KCP Alumnus Tyrone Harmon's Japan Experience](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2016/09/kcp-alumnus-tyrone-harmons-japan-experience): Summer 2016 alumnus Tyrone Harmon's photo gallery and study abroad journey
- [One on One with KCP Alumna Abigail Dunn, Part 5](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2018/08/one-on-one-with-kcp-alumna-abigail-dunn-part-5): Final part of alumna Abigail Dunn interview on KCP memories and activities

- [KCP Students Review CHATTY CHATTY Resto](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2018/04/kcp-students-restaurant-review-chatty-chatty): Student reviews of CHATTY CHATTY burger restaurant near Shinjuku Gyoen
- [Sukiya Reviews by KCP Winter 2018 Students](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2018/05/sukiya-restaurant-reviews-kcp-winter-2018-students): Winter 2018 student reviews of Sukiya gyudon restaurant chain in Japan

## Japanese Culture & History

- [Itsukushima Shrine and Its Floating Torii](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2015/03/itsukushima-shrine-and-its-floating-torii): UNESCO World Heritage Itsukushima Shrine with iconic floating torii gate
- [The Five Wisdom Kings and Five Wisdom Buddhas](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2019/11/five-wisdom-kings-five-wisdom-buddhas-japanese-buddhism): Shingon esoteric Buddhism teachings on Five Wisdom Kings and Buddhas
- [Tateishi and the Standing Stone Monument](https://www.nmstate-japan.com/2020/01/tateishi-standing-stone-monument): Tateishi-sama standing stone monument in Katsushika, Tokyo history & folklore
